question: The gastric emptying of a drug is slower:

options.opa: When the volume of intake is low.
options.opb: When the gastric content is liquid.
options.opd: When the intake is rich in lipids.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Low volume of intake" -> "Slower gastric emptying" -> 70% CHAIN: "Liquid gastric content" -> "Slower gastric emptying" -> 80% CHAIN: "Gastric pH approaching 2" -> "Slower gastric emptying" -> 90% CHAIN: "Intake rich in lipids" -> "Slower gastric emptying" -> 70%
analysis: Gastric emptying of a drug is slower when the intake is rich in lipids as lipids delay gastric emptying by forming an emulsion with gastric contents.
